integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] One continuous TEN-SECOND cinematic LIVE-ACTION shot of the EXACT two adult human actors in the opening image. Preserve their original faces, facial bones, ages, black hairlines and hair, skin, body builds, costumes, insignia and photographic materials throughout. Taller Goku LEFT wears the same heavy orange cotton gi, navy undershirt, sash, wristbands and navy boots. Shorter compact Vegeta RIGHT has the same angular face, widow's peak, upright black hair, royal-blue bodysuit, white armor with ochre ribbed panels and raised shoulder/hip guards, white gloves and white/gold boots; his brown furry tail stays around his waist. Same warm rocky canyon, shared dry ground and daylight. No face replacement, costume change, new damage, scouter or extra people.

THIS SHOT IS THE STORY TURN: Vegeta's domination ends when Goku activates KAIOKEN and starts overwhelming him. Do not produce another neutral back-and-forth sparring loop.

Opening, roughly0-1.5seconds: Vegeta drives forward with a sharp RIGHT straight into Goku's guard and an immediate LEFT body hook. His fists touch and whip clear. Goku folds at the ribs, loses ground and takes a hurried catching step. Vegeta believes he is in control and follows aggressively. Goku is defending, not winning yet.

Around1.5-2.5seconds: Goku catches his balance, plants his boots and commits. A compact CRIMSON-RED KAIOKEN aura ignites tightly around Goku's existing human body. It is transparent energy pressure, NOT literal fire, a skin recolor or a body transformation. It stirs dust outward from his boots, moves his gi and hair and gives a restrained red rim light on his costume and the nearby ground. Goku's ORIGINAL face, eyes, black hair, skin and orange/navy clothes remain clearly readable inside the aura. Vegeta stays unpowered. The activation lasts under a second; Goku launches straight out of it, without a pose hold, scream or long charging pause.

From about2.5seconds Goku SEIZES THE INITIATIVE: he steps explosively inside Vegeta's reach and unleashes a compact RIGHT cross, LEFT body hook, RIGHT straight. Each fist accelerates, makes BRIEF contact and snaps all the way back, while the next punch is already beginning. Vegeta tries to catch the cross with his high guard but the attack drives his head, shoulders and hips backward. The body hook folds him at the ribs. Two distinct hurried catching steps keep him from falling. Show Vegeta trying to parry and close his elbows, arriving too late; he is no longer successfully trading equal blows.

Goku immediately pursues those recovery steps under the SAME stable crimson Kaioken, adding quick LEFT-RIGHT-LEFT punches to the guard and ribs. Vegeta's attempted block gets knocked aside; he recoils and takes another forced step, armor and clothing following the torso. Goku's stronger short RIGHT body straight then knocks Vegeta's center of mass behind his support base, and Vegeta must step backward again. Goku follows with one last compact LEFT-RIGHT combination as Vegeta struggles to bring his guard back. End DURING Goku's pursuit and Vegeta's forced recovery, the crimson aura still attached ONLY to Goku. Do not launch Vegeta into the mountain yet; that is the next story beat.

Normal human fight speed with FAST, compact combinations and immediate retractions. The receiver's body keeps recoiling AFTER the striking fist has separated. Strong hits force actual displaced hips and catching steps, not rocking in place. Mobile defenses and asymmetric reactions. No idle bouncing, waiting turns, prolonged fist-to-guard contact, held limbs, sliding feet, floating boots or drunken swaying. No kick held against a torso. Neither character looks at the camera.

The camera has a purpose: medium-wide three-quarter side view keeps both full bodies, contact points and support boots readable; a restrained brief move toward Goku registers the Kaioken ignition, then smooth lateral tracking follows Goku's advance and Vegeta's retreat. Preserve the axis and canyon geography; do not hide contacts or faces with camera shake, flare or aura. Preserve real skin, cloth, hair and armor detail. No cuts, slow motion, retiming, orbit, full-screen red wash, opaque flames, energy beams, blonde hair, enlarged muscles, blood or text.

overall_soundscape: Compact synchronized impacts, clear forced recovery footfalls, cloth and canyon wind. A low rising energy-pressure hum accompanies Goku's Kaioken ignition and remains under the impacts. No speech, voices, screams, grunts or music.

non_diegetic_music: None.
